title.id: Awd DriveRouter v1.2.0 - Provider Telegram, Upload Batch Concurrency & Stabilitas Virtual Drive
title.en: Awd DriveRouter v1.2.0 - Telegram Provider, Concurrent Batch Upload & Virtual Drive Stability

id: Integrasi Provider Cloud Baru: Support Telegram Storage Provider (Bot Token & User Session) untuk direktori virtual dan cloud storage berbasis Telegram.
Pengunggahan Batch Konkuren: Penanganan pengunggahan file dan folder berukuran besar menggunakan Bounded Worker Pool, antrean otomatis, dan pelacakan progres real-time.
Peningkatan Stabilitas Virtual Drive: Stabilisasi mounting/unmounting drive virtual, pencegahan duplicate mount secara otomatis, serta auto-migration skema database SQLite.
Penanganan Auto-Refresh Box OAuth Token: Resolusi otomatis untuk token refresh Box yang kedaluwarsa (invalid_grant) untuk menjaga konektivitas akun background sync secara kontinu.
Pembaruan Standar Komunitas: Penambahan dokumentasi lisensi resmi (LICENSE MIT) dan panduan kode etik (CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
en: New Cloud Storage Provider: Added Telegram Storage Provider integration (Bot Token & User Session) for Telegram-backed cloud storage and Virtual Drive capabilities.
Concurrent Batch Uploads: Accelerated large file and folder uploads using a bounded worker pool, automated task queueing, and real-time upload progress tracking.
Virtual Drive & Mounting Stability: Enhanced drive mount/unmount safety, automatic duplicate mount prevention, and robust SQLite schema auto-migrations.
Box OAuth Token Auto-Refresh Handling: Resolved expired Box refresh token errors (invalid_grant) to ensure uninterrupted background account synchronization.
Community Standards & Documentation: Added official open-source license (LICENSE MIT) and contributor guidelines (CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

title.id: Awd DriveRouter v1.1.1 - Backup Rekursif, Auto-Retry HTTP 429 & Mounted Drive Ingest
title.en: Awd DriveRouter v1.1.1 - Recursive Backup, HTTP 429 Auto-Retry & Mounted Drive Ingest

id: Penelusuran rekursif subfolder backup (filepath.WalkDir) dengan optimasi In-Memory Folder Cache untuk mereplikasi hirarki direktori secara otomatis ke cloud destination.
Penanganan error HTTP 429 (TooManyRequests) dengan mekanisme Exponential Backoff Retry (retryOn429) otomatis pada OneDrive, Google Drive, & provider lain.
Pencegahan unggahan file duplikat dengan pengecekan database virtual sebelum pengunggahan berkas backup.
Penanganan izin akses (Access Denied) dengan melompati berkas tersembunyi OS & berkas sistem terkunci (desktop.ini, thumbs.db, ~$*, .DS_Store, ntuser.dat) tanpa menggagalkan tugas backup.
Tombol Cek & Sinkronkan Sekarang (Refresh) di setiap kartu tugas backup untuk pemicuan sinkronisasi instan per folder.
Dukungan penulisan pada Mounted Virtual Drive (Z:\) yang secara otomatis memindai, mendaftarkan, dan mengunggah folder/file baru buatan Windows Explorer ke cloud storage.
Resolusi konflik Drive Letter (findFirstAvailableDriveLetter) yang otomatis memilih letter kosong (Y:, X:, W:, dll.) jika letter Z: sedang terpakai.
Auto-mount Virtual Drive diaktifkan secara bawaan begitu aplikasi dijalankan.
Penggantian seluruh dialog native JavaScript (confirm/alert) dengan Modal Confirm UI Custom yang responsif dan sesuai tema.
en: Recursive subfolder backup scanning (filepath.WalkDir) with In-Memory Folder Cache optimization to replicate directory trees to cloud destinations.
Automatic exponential backoff retries (retryOn429) for OneDrive, Google Drive, & cloud providers to resolve HTTP 429 rate limit throttling (TooManyRequests).
Duplicate file upload prevention by checking existing virtual cloud database records before uploading backup files.
Access Denied / System File Filter to skip hidden OS files & locked system files (desktop.ini, thumbs.db, ~$*, .DS_Store, ntuser.dat) without interrupting backup runs.
Manual Check & Sync Now (Refresh) button on each backup task card for instant per-folder synchronization.
Mounted Virtual Drive (Z:\) write ingestion to automatically detect, save, and upload new files or folders created via Windows Explorer.
Drive Letter conflict resolution (findFirstAvailableDriveLetter) that falls back to available free letters (Y:, X:, W:, etc.) if Z: is occupied.
Automatic startup Virtual Drive mounting enabled by default whenever the application opens.
Replaced all native browser confirm and alert dialogs with responsive custom UI modals.

title.id: Awd DriveRouter v1.1.0 - Headless Server, Cloudflare Web Sharing & Perbaikan Akun
title.en: Awd DriveRouter v1.1.0 - Headless Server, Cloudflare Web Sharing & Account Fixes

id: Dukungan Mode Headless Web Server (CLI flag --server, --port, --host, --api-key & Docker/Docker Compose) untuk penggunaan tanpa antarmuka GUI.
Fitur Internal Web Sharing dengan integrasi Cloudflare Tunnel otomatis untuk membagikan file & folder publik maupun privat.
Tampilan Web Public Sharing modern lengkap dengan proteksi kata sandi, batas waktu kedaluwarsa, batas jumlah unduhan, dan pratinjau media.
Fitur Sambungkan Ulang (Re-authenticate) untuk akun cloud (Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, Box, Yandex, pCloud) agar pembaruan token tidak menduplikasi akun di database.
Perbaikan penanganan token OAuth yang kedaluwarsa secara otomatis saat sinkronisasi di latar belakang.
Integrasi WebSocket real-time untuk pemantauan progres transfer pengunggahan dan status sinkronisasi akun secara otomatis.
en: Headless Web Server mode support (CLI flags --server, --port, --host, --api-key & Docker/Docker Compose) for server and GUI-less environments.
Internal Web Sharing feature with automatic Cloudflare Tunnel integration to share files & folders publicly or privately.
Modern Public Web Sharing interface equipped with password protection, expiration timers, download limits, and media previews.
Re-authentication feature for cloud accounts (Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, Box, Yandex, pCloud) to refresh expired tokens without duplicating accounts.
Fixed expired OAuth refresh token handling during automatic background synchronization.
Real-time WebSocket integration for live upload transfer progress and account sync status updates.

title.id: Awd DriveRouter v1.0.1 - Peningkatan Responsivitas & Pembaruan Otomatis
title.en: Awd DriveRouter v1.0.1 - Faster Loading & Automatic Refresh

id: Tampilan daftar file kini terbuka seketika tanpa perlu menunggu loading lama saat memuat folder.
Penyamaan data dari berbagai akun penyimpan cloud berjalan serentak di latar belakang.
Tampilan file ter-refresh secara otomatis begitu ada pembaruan data dari cloud.
Kestabilan penyimpanan lokal ditingkatkan agar tidak terjadi hambatan saat membaca atau menulis file.
Daftar file kini secara otomatis dibersihkan jika akun terputus atau file terhapus di server cloud.
en: File list opens instantly without freezing or long loading screens when browsing folders.
Multi-cloud drive data syncing now runs simultaneously in the background.
File view automatically updates on screen whenever new data arrives from cloud accounts.
Enhanced local database stability for smoother performance.
File list automatically stays consistent when an account is unlinked or files are deleted in the cloud.

title.id: Awd DriveRouter v1.0.0 - Rilis Perdana & Fitur Pembaruan
title.en: Awd DriveRouter v1.0.0 - Initial Release & Update Features

id: Rilis perdana Awd DriveRouter.
Dukungan multi-cloud storage (Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, Box, Yandex, pCloud, WebDAV, S3, Telegram).
Aturan alokasi pengunggahan cerdas (Round-Robin, Max Free Space, Mirroring).
Fitur Cek Otomatis Pembaruan dari GitHub Releases.
Halaman 'Tentang Aplikasi', Catatan Rilis (Changelog), dan integrasi System Tray Icon.
en: Initial release of Awd DriveRouter.
Multi-cloud storage support (Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, Box, Yandex, pCloud, WebDAV, S3, Telegram).
Smart upload allocation strategies (Round-Robin, Max Free Space, Mirroring).
Automatic GitHub Release update checker.
'About App' page, Release Notes (Changelog), and System Tray Icon integration.
